summary: Frontend-only verification of iter381 statutory payroll UI (ComplianceLinesEditor, StatutoryOverrides on salary edit, Payslip preview Employer/Total cost columns, payslip card employer line, RemittanceDialog with CSV/PDF, and VendorPicker additions in PortalExpenses + AssetsRegister). All eight requested checks pass. Zero console errors across HR landing, Payslips tab, and all HR sub-tabs (Salaries/Contracts/Leave/Timesheets). Backend remittance endpoints return real data (UGX 1,141,303.57 employee / UGX 446,607.14 employer / UGX 1,587,910.71 total for 2026-01..2026-12 All payslips).

issues: When the top-left campus selector is blank on first HR page load, HR Settings dialog shows 'No statutory lines yet' and the richer compliance editor (compliance-lines-editor) is absent. Only after explicitly picking '58:12 Uganda' does the editor render. Not a bug per se — the admin had no active campus set in session — but worth noting for UX (consider auto-selecting the user's default campus).

Compliance lines state is held in parent HRPage state and NOT re-fetched when the dialog is reopened. If a user clicks 'Use progressive bands' then presses Cancel, the added band row still appears on next open. Only Save/Reload reverts. Minor — consider resetting state on open or on Cancel.

detailed_results.compliance_editor: PASS — type dropdown is a shadcn Select BUTTON (not native SELECT) with 'Deduct from staff' | 'Add to pay' | 'Employer contribution'. Switching line to Employer contribution reveals compliance-mode-N + compliance-expense-acct-N. compliance-liability-acct-N present on every line. compliance-add-bands-N adds compliance-band-upto-N-0 / compliance-band-rate-N-0 rows, and compliance-amount-N becomes disabled when bands exist. Save shows toast 'HR settings saved'.
detailed_results.statutory_overrides_persistence: PASS — Edited salary sal_b71837e5 (Christopher Ssekito): set statutory-amount-nssf_employee=7, left statutory-pct-nssf_employee checked, toggled statutory-toggle-nssf_employer OFF. Save shows 'Salary updated' toast. Reopened dialog: amount still 7, pct still checked, nssf_employer toggle still unchecked. Round-trip persistence confirmed. Cleaned up to defaults afterwards.
detailed_results.payslip_preview_columns: PASS — Preview table headers include ['Staff','Dept','Gross','Allowances','Deductions','Net','Employer','Total cost','Status']. Footer renders preview-total-employer=127,500.00 and preview-total-cost=1,402,500.00. Back button returns to generate step without creating payslips.
detailed_results.payslip_card_employer_line: PASS — Cards expose payslip-employer-<id>. Example: ps_28b355a7 shows 'Employer: +10,000 · Cost: 110,000' (Gross 100,000 + Employer 10,000 = Cost 110,000). Math consistent across all five sampled cards (ps_e215f696 +8,181.82 → 108,181.82; etc.).
detailed_results.remittance_dialog: PASS — remittance-btn opens remittance-dialog. remittance-total-employee / remittance-total-employer / remittance-total render. Setting From=2026-01, To=2026-12, Status=All, pressing remittance-refresh populates per-line totals (PAYE, NSSF Employer, NSSF Employee, PAYE second line) with per-staff sub-rows (Christopher Ssekito, Zipporah Lubega, Henry Lubega). remittance-csv downloaded 'statutory-remittance-2026-01.csv'; remittance-pdf downloaded 'statutory-remittance-2026-01.pdf'. No error toasts.
detailed_results.expense_vendor_typeahead: PASS — /portal/expenses → Add Expense opens dialog with expense-vendor-input. Typing 'air' shows suggestion 'Airtel Uganda · supplier' + 'Add “air” as a new vendor'. Clicking suggestion fills field to 'Airtel Uganda'.
detailed_results.asset_vendor_typeahead: PASS — Finance → Fixed Assets → Add asset opens dialog with asset-vendor-input. Typing 'kam' suggests 'Kampala Hardware Ltd · supplier · 0772000111'. Selecting fills vendor to 'Kampala Hardware Ltd'. The 58:12 Uganda campus has no fixed assets yet so the Spend dialog (asset-spend-vendor) could not be opened; asset-spend-vendor was therefore not visually exercised, but the component code is the same VendorPicker.
detailed_results.regression_hr_tabs: PASS — HR page loads with 0 console errors / 0 pageerrors. Salaries, Contracts, Leave, Timesheets all switch and render without errors.

action_items: (Optional UX) Auto-select the admin's primary campus on HR page load so the Compliance editor is visible without manual campus pick.
(Optional UX) Reset ComplianceLinesEditor state when the HR Settings dialog closes via Cancel, so transient 'add band' changes don't persist in local state across opens.
critical_code_review_comments: VendorPicker shows the dropdown even when there are no exact matches — the 'Add “kam” as a new vendor' row is handy but double-check that selecting it does not silently create a vendor on the server when the user just intended free-text input.
RemittanceDialog successfully downloads blobs — ensure the CSV/PDF endpoints respect the Payslips=All vs Paid only filter server-side (verified by backend pytest per handoff note).
HRPage statutory-overrides payload must preserve the pct boolean separately from amount — persistence test confirms both round-trip correctly.
seed_data_creation: None. Salary sal_b71837e5 was temporarily edited and restored. Settings were briefly modified (added a band on NSSF Employee) and then reverted / cleaned up with Save.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter381 statutory payroll UI is fully functional on the main campus (58:12 Uganda, loc_419f5d5e). Three statutory lines configured: PAYE (progressive bands), NSSF Employee 5%, NSSF Employer 10%. 48 payslips exist with employer-contribution lines rendered. The only UX nit is that HR Settings compliance editor only appears after a campus is explicitly selected (first page load after login shows empty campus → 'No statutory lines yet').
